captions.detailed: This 3D model is a simple, square-shaped portion control container with an open top. It features thin, uniform walls and a flat solid bottom. Two identical flat, rectangular handles project outwards horizontally from the top edges of two opposing sides, acting as convenient tabs.
captions.instruction: Create a customizable, open-top square container with two flat handles extending from the top edges. The user should be able to configure the width and depth using 'container_size_dimension' and the height using 'container_size_z', with the handle length dynamically scaling to two-thirds of the container's width.
captions.factory: The script uses the 'difference' boolean operator to hollow out a main 'cube' with a slightly smaller concentric 'cube', creating the thin-walled container. Two additional flat 'cube' primitives representing the handles are defined with a thickness of 2 units and a width of 15 units. These handle cubes are translated to the top-outer edges on opposite sides of the container and joined to the main body.
